question: Dated top-up (2026-11-22) of gbrain-install-openclaw-760-2026-11, written after that run and before these trials. Seven GPT-6.1 Sol trials of that run (bare r7 to r10, paste r7, r9 and r10) ended as model_error because the shard's metering lease was set too low: the proxy reserves a request's worst case before forwarding it, and those reservations would have passed the $13 and $18 shard leases (committed spend was $9.12 and $14.34). That is our lease sizing, not the model. The runner never reruns a recorded trial under the same run id, so this run id holds the replacement trials: GPT-6.1 Sol bare 4 runs and paste 3 runs, with the task, gbrain tag, arms, OpenClaw pin and scorer unchanged from the run spec in ../openclaw-760/run.json. The seven model_error records stay in the first run's trials.jsonl, unchanged, and are reported. Spend cap: what remains of the rerun's $101.
